issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings as a private attribute ( '-' ), but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and inheritance design (they are instructed to add public getters for attributes and to follow the UML).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings attribute private to match the UML (and provide the public getter as specified). Alternatively, if protected visibility was intentional, update the UML/problem statement to indicate protected visibility so students know the intended access level.
